rationale.intervention_reconstruction: The hypothesis proposes adding Ti to NbMoTaW, while the paper added Re and compared NbMoTaW with NbMoTaWRe films. Both are compositional modifications of the same base alloy, but the specific element differs.
rationale.condition_agreement: The hypothesis mentions vacuum arc melting or SLM synthesis and unspecified irradiation conditions, whereas the paper used magnetron-sputtered films and specific 120 keV He2+ irradiation at room temperature. The regimes differ substantially.
rationale.mechanism_agreement: The hypothesis invokes enhanced grain boundary cohesion and dislocation activity for ductility, while the paper's mechanism relies on defect-sink sites (grain boundaries, lattice distortion, amorphous regions) suppressing He-bubble growth and embrittlement. These are different mechanism classes.
rationale.outcome_agreement: The hypothesis predicts improved room-temperature ductility and retained high-temperature strength and irradiation resistance. The paper's outcome is improved He-irradiation resistance (less hardening, less embrittlement) at room temperature, with no high-temperature testing. The predicted property and direction partially overlap only on irradiation resistance.
